item.title: Stars and politicians mourn Dolly Parton: 'A true loss for millions'
item.description: President Trump announced plans to lower the American flag nationwide for a week in honor of Dolly Parton.

item.title: Tennessee honors Dolly Parton, who never forgot her home state
item.description: The passing of country music icon Dolly Parton resonated globally, especially in her home state of Tennessee.

item.title: Judge clears all legal obstacles to Trump mail-in ballot order
item.description: The ruling removes judicial blocks, allowing the president's executive order to proceed.

item.title: Which U.S. states face the most impact from Canadian tariffs
item.description: Canadian officials describe the tariffs on over 800 U.S. imports as strategic, aiming to affect specific states.
